name: Kanban
description: A Kanban board kept in this Garden's data: columns and cards you add, edit, drag and delete. Agents you allow can add and move cards too.

reasons.agents:read: to list your agents in the Thread panel, when you open it
reasons.thread:read: to show your Thread with the agent you pick in that panel
reasons.thread:post: so you can write to that agent and send it the board
reasons.store:read: to show this board's columns and cards, and changes as they happen
reasons.store:write: to save the columns and cards you add, move, edit or delete
